items.title: How to choose a school
items.body: Think about curriculum, distance and travel time, language support, and fees. Visit if you can and talk to other parents.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Check with the official regulator
items.body: Each emirate has an official school regulator that publishes information about schools. Use it to confirm what a school tells you.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Curriculums you will see
items.body: Schools follow different curriculums, such as British, American, Indian, International Baccalaureate, UAE Ministry and others. Ask how each fits your child's past and future schooling.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Documents schools usually ask for
items.body: Passport and residency copies for the child and parents, Emirates ID if issued, birth certificate, previous school reports and a transfer certificate. Some documents may need attestation, so ask the school.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Questions to ask a school
items.body: Is there a waiting list? What support is there for children who are new to the language? How do transport and school meals work? What are all the fees?
